title: Triangle Jazz Blues on record and the part Leclerc adds
summary: They look at a recording and score of the tune; Leclerc recognises a part he always played and added to, not written by him.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made
